pins.footprint_pad: pad 1 at x=-1.0 (rear row y=-2.85); body opening faces +y, so pin 1 is on the left looking into the mouth: matches JST front view
pins.issue: Design assumes pin 1 = VBAT (+). JST PH has no standard battery polarity: vendors wire red to either pin. Board relies on J2 silk "+" and the pack check in docs/assembly.md / bringup.md step 0 (reversed cell destroys TP4056). Open: confirm the chosen 403450 pack's plug has red on pin 1.
